title: An Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs in the namespace onboarding API in Google Cloud GKE Fleet versions prior to…
description: A vulnerability in the namespace onboarding API of Google Cloud GKE Fleet prior to 2026-09-25 allows an authenticated attacker to escalate privileges to project owner by exploiting an incomplete list of disallowed inputs. This issue was patched on 25 September 2026, and no customer action is required.
